cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem předmětu je naučit studenty základním pojmům v plynové a kapalinové chromatografii. Pro potřeby instrumentace vytvořit vztahy pro případné úpravy před chromatografickou analýzou. Kvantifikaci chromatografické analýzy vztáhnout pro upravené vzorky biologické matrice.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to teach students the basic concepts in gas and liquid chromatography. For needs instrumentation make adjustments before chromatographic analysis. Relate quantification of chromatographic analysis for treated biological matrix samples.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Separation techniques in GC and HPLC (allowance 2/0) a.Resolution of separation techniques for GC and HPLCb.Selection of phase separationc.Solubility of phases2.The chromatographic methods according to phases (allowance 0/2) a.direct calibration methodsb.calibration curve method3.chromatographic curves (allowance 0/2) a.linearity of the curveb.linearity range4.apparatus assembly GC (allowance 2/0) a.partial elements and columnsb.sample dosing5.separation columns (allowance 2/0) a.packed separation columnsb.capillary separation columns6.sampling (allowance 2/0) a.chromatographic syringeb.valve dosing7.separation columns (allowance 2/0) a.columns with sorbent onlyb.wetted columns8.detectors and their properties (allowance 2/0) a.detectors pflanenoionizationb.mass detectorsc.conductivity detector9.HPLC techniques (allowance 2/0) a.mobile phase selectionb.detectors in HPLCc.mobile phase flow10.determination of constituents in biological matrix (allowance 2/0) a.an aqueous biological matrixb.concentrated biological matrix11.ionization detection (allowance 2/0) a.generation of ionizing currentb.converting the current to a chromatographic signal12.chromatographic record (allowance 2/0) a.signal processing in the timelineb.linearity of the responsec.peak symmetry13.quantification of results (allowance 0/0) a.direct calibrationb.according to the calibration line
